about: Research data files under data/research that no non-test file in src/ or scripts/ reads, and why (tests/guards/research-data-has-reader.test.ts). rawSource entries are evidence the game is not meant to read. awaitingReader entries are research waiting for the code that should read it: that list may only shrink (the guard holds it at or under its ceiling), so an entry must leave in the same change that gives its file a reader. Each names its engine and the squad that owns its reader, from docs/codex/audit-by-engine-2026-10-01.md. A new data file with no reader and no entry fails the guard.

rawSource.reason: Scan output listing the placeholder and unresearched markers found in src on one commit; evidence for the stopgap audit, not game data.
Raw enacted-bill sample, the evidence the lever table and docs/research/bill-samples were measured from; the game reads what was measured, not the sample.
Raw enacted-bill sample, the evidence the lever table and docs/research/bill-samples were measured from; the game reads what was measured, not the sample.

Raw BDS business-dynamics rows for Puerto Rico, the evidence the business-opening and closing rates cite (docs/research/requests/businesses-owners-and-wealth.json). Its only readers were the roadmap M1-08 check, which since 622a9b251e tests openings and closings by record and no longer reads the state's BDS rates.

Raw poll evidence (YouGov Daily Question, September 16, 2022, with crossbreaks): the figures the policy-support row for ban-the-box in public hiring uses are copied from it with their citation; the game does not read the file.
Raw research evidence on the measured effects of ban the box (26 sourced findings); the outcome-web link for the question will cite it. The game does not read the file.
Raw source the game does not read directly: input to data/research/housing/build_core_data.py, which writes data the game reads. Its only direct reader was the old engine, deleted Oct 28, 2026.

Raw JOLTS monthly turnover rates by industry and state (2001 to 2019), the evidence behind the job-turnover parameters (docs/pool/items/world-job-turnover-far-below-jolts.md). Its only reader was the roadmap M1-04 check, which since 0a0d2b3ea5 tests causes by record and no longer reads the state's recorded bands.
Raw source the game does not read directly: source cited by data/laws/justice/lw17-person-landings.json. Its only direct reader was the old engine, deleted Oct 28, 2026.

Raw research evidence on how long unemployment lasts by age (FRED mean and median weeks, CPS duration), fetched Nov 8, 2026 for the registered estimate that finding work slows past age 40 (420176cbb9); the game reads the estimate's parameter row, not this file.

Raw research result for ten outcome-web link sizes (quote, conversion, value, range, verifier's finding each); a later family copies a size into the link's row in links.json, which the outcome web reads, and the game never reads this file.
Research on the number stand-ins open on Oct 12, 2026 (class, current value, recommended value or bounds, source); builders apply rows into the parameter tables.

Raw research result for the open stopgap rows (value, spread, sources, one-line builder note each); builders apply a row into the game's own data and resolve its stopgap (pool item research-stopgaps-oct19-apply), the game never reads the file.

awaitingReader.reason: Law catalog terms, batch 2; the old engine's legal-outcome.ts cites it as a source but nothing reads the file. Owner: the Coordinator owns the shared law path the catalog feeds.
The 61 kinds of bill part (04 SYSTEM SPECS, spec 3); no bill builder reads it yet. Owner: Team 1 owns lawmaking, where bill parts are built.

Sourced callback gaps from field experiments, waiting for the hiring engine to read employer attitudes (pool items world-hiring-bias-reasons and world-sale-eligibility-reads); nothing in the engine reads it yet. Owner: Team 3 owns pay and jobs, where an employer's answer to an applicant is decided.
